about: Key moments for chapter 32, seeded by the project as a starting point.

jobs.prompt: Wide view of a footpath through a wooded district lined with old stone houses and tall trees. To the left, a workman on a tall ladder leaning against a tree tosses a security camera down into a box on the ground already full of dozens of discarded cameras, mid-throw. Two figures in privacy robes walk along the path past him. Farther along, a small shop front displays rows of bright red flowers. Soft daylight, muted greens, stone greys.

View from a pedestrian sky bridge over a busy highway with small autonomous buses and cars below. Two figures in privacy robes stand at the railing looking out. To the left rises a mountain covered with trees, and above the treetops on its slope stand a few fifteen-storey apartment buildings shaped like oversized medieval castle towers, with many windows. Dense shrubbery at the end of the bridge. Bright daylight, muted greens and stone greys.

Medium shot in a quiet government office with wood paneling and stone walls. The man from reference image 1 stands before a large map of an unfamiliar world painted on the wall, continents and seas only, with no labels, gesturing toward it thoughtfully. The young man from reference image 2 sits in a chair and listens intently. Another man and a woman sit nearby, seen from behind. Soft daylight from a window, muted greens and warm wood.

Wide view from a rooftop partway up a forested mountain over a green city. The man from reference image 1 stands at the edge holding a cup of tea in one hand and a dish of rice and vegetables in the other, gazing out with a contented smile; the woman from reference image 2 stands beside him. Below spreads a commercial district of old-style and modern buildings, one shaped like an aeroplane, a grey-and-purple walled square, and a forest-like district of tall trees. Castle-tower apartments rise on the slope to the right. Warm daylight.
